description: Defines an abstract base class for Drupal filter plugins, providing common properties and methods for filter plugin implementations.

classes.name: FilterBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for Drupal filter plugins, including configuration management and plugin metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter plugin with configuration, plugin ID, and plugin definition.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the filter's configuration properties based on provided array.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the current configuration of the filter plugin.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration values for the filter plugin.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Returns an array of dependencies; default is empty.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the filter plugin.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label/title of the filter plugin.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the filter plugin.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Provides a form array for filter settings; default returns empty array.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares or processes the input text; default returns input unchanged.

methods.name: getHTMLRestrictions
methods.description: Indicates if HTML restrictions apply; default returns FALSE.

methods.name: tips
methods.description: Provides tips or guidance; default is empty.
